q: What kind of projects does Hatify Labs take on?
a: The complex ones. Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, production LLM and RAG systems, voice agents, government-grade ERPs, regulated data architectures and heavy automation. If your project makes other agencies nervous, it is probably a good fit for us.

q: Do you work with government and regulated industries?
a: Yes — we have delivered ERP systems inside government departments and design HIPAA-conscious architectures for healthcare data. We are comfortable with on-premise deployments, strict audit requirements and the paperwork that comes with them.

q: How do you handle data security?
a: As a default, not a feature. Encryption at rest and in transit, least-privilege access, tenant isolation up to database-per-tenant, audit trails and secrets management are part of our standard build — because retrofitting security is always more expensive than including it.

Three models: fixed-scope builds for well-defined projects, monthly retainers for ongoing product work, and dedicated teams for long-running programs. Every engagement starts with a scoped discovery so the estimate is grounded in reality.

q: Can you take over an existing codebase?
a: Yes. We start with a technical audit — architecture, security, performance, test coverage — then agree on a stabilization plan before adding features. We inherit systems carefully; we do not rewrite for sport.
Discovery can usually begin within a week of first contact. For urgent production issues — outages, security concerns, launch deadlines — we can move faster. Reach out and tell us what is on fire.
